description: Aspose.Cells Cloud SDK for C++ (native). A generated client for the Aspose.Cells Cloud REST API (468 operations, 41 controllers). Ships the asposecellscloud static library and, for Windows, the asposecellscloud_dll DLL with its import library and runtime dependencies, plus public headers, vendored nlohmann/json, and MSBuild integration for native (vcxproj) projects. Platforms: linux-x64, win-x64 (Release).
summary: Aspose.Cells Cloud SDK for C++ (native static library).
title: Aspose.Cells Cloud SDK for C++
